name: Aurora Desk Lamp
shortDescription: A dimmable aluminum desk lamp with warm ambient glow for focused work.
description: Aurora balances directional task lighting with a soft ambient edge, making it ideal for home offices, reading corners, and studio workstations.
highlights: Stepless dimmer with warm-to-neutral light control
Weighted base with low-profile cable routing

name: Field Note Backpack
shortDescription: A weather-resistant everyday backpack sized for a 16-inch laptop and weekend carry.
description: Field Note uses recycled ripstop nylon, magnetic quick-access pockets, and a modular interior that transitions from commute mode to short travel.
highlights: Padded internal sleeve for laptops up to 16 inches
Expandable side pockets for bottle or umbrella storage
Breathable back panel for all-day comfort

name: Atlas Ceramic Mug
shortDescription: A hand-finished stoneware mug designed for daily coffee rituals and clean stacking.
description: Atlas pairs a comfortable loop handle with a satin glaze finish that resists stains and fits seamlessly into minimalist kitchen setups.
highlights: Stackable base for compact shelf storage

name: Signal Wireless Speaker
shortDescription: A compact Bluetooth speaker with room-filling sound and a tactile aluminum control dial.
description: Signal is tuned for warm mids and clear vocals, with a battery profile that covers full workdays and casual evenings indoors or out.
highlights: Up to 14 hours of playback on a single charge
Bluetooth multipoint pairing for two devices
Textured acoustic grille with premium tactile finish
